scope: M4 development source, incremental migration plan, and loopback demonstration candidate
initialFindings: miniapp order parser did not accept the complete legal M4 state/version combinations
stale frontend detail or action responses could overwrite a newer route or access context
cross-principal result lookup could incorrectly return a successful null
task and receipt reads could observe a torn snapshot
DDL CHECK constraints allowed SQL NULL to bypass lease/reason requirements
decimal expectedVersion, fence, or receiptSeq values could be truncated
repairsVerified: parser accepts the legal v1/v2 and v3+ state combinations and rejects invalid combinations
detail and action responses are guarded by generation, order, and access context
order ownership is proven before result lookup and cross-principal access returns 404
admin and miniapp reads use a repeatable-read snapshot with task/receipt consistency checks
lease time and failure reason constraints explicitly reject NULL
expectedVersion, fence, and receiptSeq require integral JSON numbers within Long range
authorizedNextSteps: apply the reviewed incremental migration to the development print_demo database after verified backup
deploy the reviewed loopback demonstration candidate
execute runtime permission, concurrency, idempotency, lease, recovery, immutability, and re-entry checks
knownLimitations: admin full vue-tsc ran out of memory twice and is not PASS; changed-file ESLint and Vite build passed
review and tests do not constitute WeChat device acceptance
real payment, refund, object storage, and physical printing were not run
this review is not production-release approval or external user acceptance
